2609.01168.title: Jailbreaking Text-to-Image Models Through Cracks: Navigating Heterogeneous Safety Filters via Multi-Agent Debate
2609.01168.paper_summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) content, despite increasingly being guarded by heterogeneous, multi-layer safety stacks combining text filters, image classifiers, and cross-modal detectors. Existing jailbreak studies either optimize against individual filters or query the complete pipeline with aggregate feedback, making it difficult to identify the active constraint and adapt to conflicts across safety layers.In this paper, we introduce the \emph{Detection Surface}, a unified geometric framework that characterizes the decision boundaries induced by heterogeneous T2I safety filters and their joint effect on the jailbreak search space. This formulation reveals that successful evasion is governed by a sparse and non-convex region shaped by cross-layer conflicts, where mutations that bypass one filter may increase exposure to another. Motivated by this analysis, we propose \emph{CRACK}, a multi-agent debate framework for adaptive jailbreak search that decomposes jailbreak search into exploration, diagnosis, and arbitration. CRACK coordinates an Attack Agent, a Defense Agent, and a Judge Agent to iteratively generate prompt mutations, obtain layer-specific diagnostic feedback, and optimize mutation strategies through reward-guided refinement. Through repeated rounds of debate, CRACK adapts its search direction to the evolving cross-layer constraints while preserving the original harmful intent. Extensive experiments across multiple T2I models, datasets, and safety configurations show that CRACK achieves Attack Success Rates (ASR) of up to 99.63\% under composite defenses, while requiring fewer queries than existing methods and maintaining semantic fidelity.
2609.01168.paper_summary_zh: 文本到圖像（T2I）模型仍然容易受到越獄攻擊，這些攻擊引發不適合工作的（NSFW）內容，儘管這些模型越來越受到異質的多層安全堆疊的保護，這些堆疊結合了文本過濾器、圖像分類器和跨模態檢測器。現有的越獄研究要麼針對個別過濾器進行優化，要麼對整個管道進行聚合反饋查詢，這使得識別活動約束並適應安全層之間的衝突變得困難。在本文中，我們介紹了\emph{檢測表面}，這是一個統一的幾何框架，描述了異質T2I安全過濾器所引起的決策邊界及其對越獄搜索空間的聯合影響。這一表述揭示了成功逃避是由一個稀疏且非凸的區域所主導，這個區域是由跨層衝突所形成的，在這裡，繞過一個過濾器的突變可能會增加對另一個過濾器的暴露。受到這一分析的啟發，我們提出了\emph{CRACK}，一個多代理辯論框架，用於自適應越獄搜索，將越獄搜索分解為探索、診斷和仲裁。CRACK協調一個攻擊代理、一個防禦代理和一個法官代理，迭代生成提示突變，獲取層特定的診斷反饋，並通過獎勵引導的精煉來優化突變策略。通過重複的辯論回合，CRACK調整其搜索方向以適應不斷演變的跨層約束，同時保持原始的有害意圖。在多個T2I模型、數據集和安全配置下的廣泛實驗顯示，CRACK在復合防禦下達到高達99.63\%的攻擊成功率（ASR），同時所需的查詢次數少於現有方法，並保持語義忠實性。
